name: Advanced 3D Printing Materials
what: New materials for 3D printing offer improved mechanical properties and thermal stability.
how: These materials enable the creation of more durable and efficient parts in various industries.

name: DED Titanium
what: Directed Energy Deposition for adding metal to existing parts or creating massive structures.
how: A laser melts metal powder as it is deposited, allowing for grade-5 titanium structures.

name: Directed Energy Deposition
what: High-power laser cladding used to repair high-value components or create large-scale parts.
how: Powder or wire is melted as it is deposited by a nozzle, building layers of metal.

name: Industrial 3D Printing
what: High-throughput additive production of end-use parts.
how: Layer-by-layer fusion from CAD instructions.

name: Large-Scale Metal Sintering

name: Multi-Material Ceramic Printing
what: Ability to print complex ceramic parts with varying porosity and composition.
how: Direct Ink Writing (DIW) using multi-nozzle arrays to deposit diverse ceramic slurries.

name: Multi-Material Jetting
what: Simultaneous printing of multiple materials with varying hardness and color.
how: Inkjet-style heads deposit different polymers and UV-cure them instantly.

name: Two-Photon Polymerization
what: Ultra-high resolution 3D printing at the sub-micron level.
how: Two photons are absorbed simultaneously by a molecule, allowing for extremely localized polymerization at the focal point.

name: Metal Binder Jetting
what: A faster route to metal parts that prints binder onto metal powder and then sinters the shape solid.
how: Inkjet heads deposit binder layer by layer to form a fragile 'green' part, which is de-bound and sintered in a furnace into dense metal.

name: 4D Adaptive Materials
what: 3D printed objects that change shape or property over time in response to stimuli.

name: 4D Morphing Materials
what: 3D printed objects that change shape or property over time in response to stimuli.

name: 4D Printed Shape-Shifters

name: Metallic Additive Manufacturing

name: Multi-material 3D Printing

name: Volumetric Additive Manufacturing
what: Printing 3D objects instantly by projecting light into a volume of photosensitive resin.

name: Volumetric Tomography

name: 4D Programmable Matter

name: Regolith Sintering
what: Using high-power lasers to fuse lunar soil into solid structures.

name: 4D Printing

name: Volumetric Printing
what: Printing a whole object almost at once by solidifying resin throughout a volume rather than layer by layer.

name: Atomic Layer Assembly
